I've looked for days and found only one.  There locations arent right from the TB map.
Do you have to do any prior quest to get this one?  I went to Sir. Sj but he has no question mark over his head and when I click on him nothing happens? anybody know why? thanks
replies:
All three mastery quest chains have the quest "Welcome to the Jungle" as prerequisite. 

Just go up to Barnil Stonepot in the same camp, who in turn directs you (via the mini-quest) to Nesingwary.  Once this is done, all three quest chains will be unlocked.

If you visit the camp past mid 30's, the yellow [b][Yellow]![/Yellow][/b] might not be shown (having grayed out).  Don't be alarmed, just talk to Barnil and get the above mentioned mini-quest done.
